notes: SHIP v1.14.383 - COMMAND SHELL DESKTOP. Owner on device: 'the desktop layout is still behaving like a stretched mobile interface.' Correct, and this fixes it. .382 shipped only the PHONE composition; at desktop the shell had no rules of its own, so it inherited the legacy Command layout and looked like a widened phone. Desktop is now a SEPARATE COMPOSITION per spec 9: persistent left navigation, a large central Active Deployment workspace, a right-side PHANTOM Intelligence panel, and NO bottom navigation. Still entirely behind the non-persistent ?cshell=1 flag. MOBILE IS UNCHANGED AND THAT WAS VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED: every rule in this ship lives inside @media (min-width:851px), and at 390x844 the measured shell is identical to .382 - hero 334x343 at 26px radius, shell 362x634, bottom nav present, app header present, phone header present, all desktop chrome display:none, #pg-cmd untouched at display:flex/left:0, zero horizontal overflow. WHAT LANDED: 9.4 sidebar at 246px - brand, active-site status, primary nav, operations group, profile, secure-session, version stamp; active item gets a cyan edge and a subtle cyan/violet wash with no oversized glow. 9.5 topbar at 76px - sticky, dark translucent, 22px blur, page title, 240x38 search wired to the REAL doSearchDebounced/doSearchNow, blocker-count notification, 38px cyan-to-violet SCAN. 9.6 content area at 24px/28px/46px, max 1640px, centred. 9.7 three-column dashboard - minmax(520px,1.55fr) minmax(300px,0.8fr) minmax(270px,0.68fr), hero spanning two rows, NOT an equal card grid. 9.8 desktop hero at 425px with the SAME approved Deploy artwork at much larger scale, 35px title, 54% progress, 25px padding, plus the technical grid overlay - crop and overlay only, the art is never recut or replaced. 9.9 Intelligence panel. 9.10 Site Health. 9.11 Build Progress. 9.13-9.16 lower grid at 1.1fr/1.1fr/0.8fr - Field Operations, Field Tools, Shift Readiness. 10.3 compact laptop 851-1199: sidebar collapses to 82px, labels hide, dashboard and lower grid go two-column, and the bottom nav does NOT come back. 10.4 full desktop and 10.5 ultrawide capped at 1640px. ALL ARTWORK IS EXISTING AND APPROVED, none generic, none placeholder: the hero reuses icons/DEPLOY-phone@3x.webp; the six Field Tools tiles use the approved 768 tool set - bom, manifest, portmap, audits, power and ref-optics - and BOTH documented naming traps were honoured, BLAST is fed by the POWER raster and OPTICS is a ref- file not a tool- file; Field Operations uses OPS-phone@3x and phantom-feat-handoff-v2; the sidebar glyphs are the approved nav-v2 set; the brand mark is phantom-prism. Every one of those files was confirmed on disk AND in PRECACHE_URLS before use, so the shell is fully offline-capable and no precache entry needed to change. Items with no approved icon use a two-letter mono token rather than a substitute icon. EVERY DOOR IS AN EXISTING DOOR - showMode, cmd_route, rd_openOpsTool, cmd_loadMaster, rd_openProfile, openVaSheet, doSearchNow. No new feature logic, no second entry point for anything. NO FAKE DATA. Site Health renders the four signals this app ACTUALLY has - connection, storage, site profile, open blockers - not the spec mock's power domains / network fabric / documentation rows, which have no data source in PHANTOM. Build Progress is the real DEPLOY_PHASE_TYPES aggregate from deploy_computeDeployRollup and shows an honest empty state when there is no deployment. Shift Readiness does NOT reproduce the mock's fixed 82% ring - a hardcoded readiness score is fake telemetry - it is four real gates (profile confirmed, Master loaded, zero blockers, handoff started) so the number moves when the shift moves. Live Activity (9.12) is NOT built: the app has no event log, and the honest substrate is the completedAt/completedBy fields on checklist criteria, which is its own ship. The spec's Defer action on the Intelligence panel is also absent - there is no defer state, and a button that silently does nothing is worse than an absent one. FIVE DEFECTS FOUND BY THE IN-BROWSER PASS, NOT BY READING: (1) the legacy desktop rules target #cc-center by ID, giving TWO ids, which out-specifies any class-scoped shell rule - the shell was trapped in a 226px grid row with legacy content overlapping it. Fixed by overriding #pg-cmd back to display:block and targeting the zones by ID. This is the SECOND time this session that an id-carrying rule silently beat a shell rule. (2) .page is position:absolute with inset:0 inside a position:relative .main, so an absolutely positioned box resolves against the containing block's PADDING BOX and padding on .main moved it zero pixels; the workspace now offsets .page itself. (3) cs_renderReady was called after the build rail's two early returns, so readiness silently never rendered in the cold-start case - hoisted above them. (4) the Field Operations title and metadata are spans and ran together on one line without display:block. (5) the readiness rows are .cs-rrow while the warn dot rule targeted .cs-hrow, so every OPEN gate rendered a healthy mint dot - a lie, now gold. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge in the sidebar footer reads v1.14.383. (2) PHONE FIRST at ?cshell=1 - it must be pixel-identical to .382, bottom nav included. If anything moved on the phone, the breakpoint leaked and that outranks everything else. (3) Bare URL still identical to .381 on phone AND desktop. (4) ?legacy=1 unchanged. (5) Desktop at ?cshell=1 - sidebar left, hero centre, Intelligence right, NO bottom nav, tool cards showing real art. (6) Drag the window across 851px and 1200px: 82px rail then 246px rail, two columns then three, and the bottom nav must never reappear above 851px. (7) Tap every sidebar and tool destination - all should land on the existing screens. (8) Zero horizontal overflow at 390, 851, 1000, 1440, 1728.
